sources.quote: Alpha Mensae, also named Hoerikwaggo, is the brightest star in the constellation Mensa.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.0 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,496 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

sources.quote: At a magnitude of 5.09, it is the dimmest lucida in the sky, and the second-faintest star labeled "alpha", after Alpha Octantis.
